description: This file defines the DubService class implementing AnalyticsService, handling OAuth token management and event tracking via the Dub API, and exports a factory function to create instances.

classes.name: DubService
classes.description: Implements AnalyticsService, manages OAuth tokens, initializes Dub client, and sends event data.

methods.name: initClient
methods.description: Fetches app keys, checks token expiry, refreshes token if needed, and initializes Dub client.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth token using refresh token, updates credential store, and handles errors.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Initializes client and sends event data via Dub API.
